projectName: i need you to build me a stand alone app

nodes.label: config.ts
nodes.description: Configuration and constant definitions for the layout editor. Imports: none. Exports: a constant 'LAYOUT_CONFIG' object containing default dimensions, widget types, and file paths for the Jarvis metadata. Handles: default settings for the canvas and file paths for the 'jarvis' core data.

nodes.label: types.ts
nodes.description: Centralized type definitions for the application. Imports: none. Exports: interfaces for Widget (id, type, x, y, width, height), Layout (id, items: Widget[]), and AppConfig. Ensures strict typing across the editor and the core logic.

nodes.label: jarvis-scanner.py
nodes.description: A Python script designed to scan the 'Jarvis' main application source or directory to extract available widget definitions. Imports: os, json. Exports: a list of widget schemas. Handles: file system traversal, parsing of Jarvis-specific configuration files, and filtering of valid widgets.

nodes.label: widget_loader.ts
nodes.description: Logic to ingest the output from the jarvis-scanner.py and map it to the internal 'Widget' type. Imports: types.ts. Exports: a function 'loadAvailableWidgets()' returning an array of objects. Handles: empty scan results and malformed widget data.

nodes.label: canvas_manager.ts
nodes.description: Manages the state of the drag-and-drop canvas. Imports: types.ts. Exports: a class 'CanvasManager' with methods like 'moveWidget(id, x, y)', 'addWidget(type)', and 'getCurrentLayout()'. Handles: collision detection, snapping to grid, and coordinate validation.

nodes.label: persistence_service.ts
nodes.description: Handles saving and loading the layout JSON file. Imports: types.ts. Exports: 'saveLayout(data: Layout)' and 'loadLayout()'. Handles: File System errors, permission issues, and invalid JSON formatting.

nodes.label: ui_main_canvas.tsx
nodes.description: The primary React component for the drag-and-drop interface. Imports: canvas_manager.ts, widget_loader.ts. Exports: the rendered canvas component. Handles: mouse events for dragging, selection highlighting, and rendering of the canvas grid.

nodes.label: ui_widget_library.tsx
nodes.description: A sidebar component listing all widgets discovered by the scanner. Imports: widget_loader.ts. Exports: a list of selectable widgets. Handles: empty states and selection highlighting.

nodes.label: ui_toolbar.tsx
nodes.description: Top bar containing action buttons like 'Save Layout', 'Reset', and 'Preview'. Imports: persistence_service.ts. Exports: the UI component. Handles: click events for state changes.

nodes.label: main_entry.ts
nodes.description: The entry point for the layout editor application. Imports: ui_main_canvas.tsx, ui_widget_library.tsx, ui_toolbar.tsx. Exports: the application root. Handles: initial state setup and global error boundaries.

nodes.label: test_persistence.spec.ts
nodes.description: Unit tests for the persistence_service.ts. Imports: persistence_service.ts. Ensures that file I/O works correctly and handles edge cases like read-only directories.

nodes.label: test_canvas_logic.spec.ts
nodes.description: Unit tests for canvas_manager.ts. Imports: canvas_manager.ts. Validates move calculations and coordinate wrapping.
